definitions.gloss: small face; having a small face (as a beauty ideal)
definitions.explanation: A face that looks small in proportion to the body. In Japan a small face is widely considered attractive, and the word is common in compliments, fashion magazines and beauty advertising.

examples.japanese: {小顔|こがお}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: To make one's face look smaller.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦モデル→モデル：05112_moderu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{小顔|こがお}だ⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: That model really has a small face.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美容院|びよういん}→美容院：06319_biyouin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧「{小顔|こがお}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦{髪型|かみがた}→髪型：14646_kamigata⟧にして⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: At the hair salon, I asked for a hairstyle that would make my face look smaller.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Telling someone ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧ or {小顔|こがお}だ⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧ is a compliment in Japan, though it can puzzle English speakers. There are {小顔|こがお}⟦マッサージ→マッサージ：00272_massaaji⟧ (face-slimming massages) and make-up techniques to look {小顔|こがお}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小顔|こがお}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧ / ⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧: to look / make look small-faced
- {小顔|こがお}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧: a face-slimming effect
